title: Non-materializing Memory count and bounded scans
description: Optimize MemoryTransaction count_prefix, first, and scan_range(limit) so they can avoid building a full merged Vec when the caller only needs a count, first row, or limited prefix.
constraints: Preserve MemoryTransaction read-your-own-writes and tombstone behavior
Reuse a shared merge traversal to avoid semantic drift
convergence_criteria: MemoryTransaction::count_prefix no longer calls scan_prefix to count
MemoryTransaction::first no longer calls scan_range to take one row
